main_body: A woven mat or drying-rack panel (yellow with blue pattern) in a brown wooden frame, with a thin front rail and short legs
top_band: Yellow mat, rows 2-16 (x=15: light #d8bb68 rows 2-4, then #bc9a45 down to row 16). This fills almost the whole object and reads as a flat slab seen from above, not a foreshortened top band.
evidence: The mat takes about 15 of the 21 rows, so it is a top-down plan of a slab. Below it is only a thin brown rail (rows 17-19) and two stubby legs, which is a lip rather than a real front face. The frame has no readable beams or uprights with their own top faces, so the structure matches the red top-down slab in the guide. There is a front edge line but no eave shadow and no recessed front.

style.evidence: The outline is a tinted dark brown, with 0% neutral edge pixels, so it is not a sticker line. There are no flat fills. The yellow mat has only about 4 steps plus a few teal accents, against roughly 6 on the references. It has only 15 distinct colours against 38-40 for the references, and 12 colours per tile against 17-20. The weave texture is simple and repetitive, so it is thinner than the references.
